record.name: Podio
record.one_liner: Work management and collaboration platform providing customizable workspaces, apps, and CRM tools.
record.access_note: You have to sign in or sign up with Podio and find your API keys in your account settings.
record.api_note: Covers workspaces, apps, items, tasks, files, comments, and webhooks via standard API areas.

evidence.quote: The Podio API uses the OAuth2 protocol for authentication.
The Podio API is available to use for both paid and free Podio accounts.
You can find full reference documentation right here on this site under API Areas.

flags_before.detail: api is backed only by non-vendor pages
mcp=official but no vendor-owned page or vendor GitHub org cited
